name: Concepción
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Concepción Municipality’s official Dirección de Obras Municipales maintains the comuna’s urbanization/building cadastre and its SIG DOM allows property-background lookup using a supplied address or assessment-roll number. The municipality’s information concerns its planning/building function and is not evidence of legal title registration. An independent SII-derived user-hosted ArcGIS layer was queried at the exact WUP point using only OBJECTID and geometry and returned zero features; the SII interoperation service itself is limited to specifically authorized municipal staff, so it was not accessed.
technicalBlocker: No source-native anonymous response containing a complete polygon at the exact WUP point was verified in this city-specific investigation. This is an unverified access finding, not a claim that public parcel geometry does not exist.
scopeLimits: Local registry/cadastre custody and safe public geometry are assessed separately. No complete parcel geometry at the exact WUP point was retained; no citywide or countrywide coverage is asserted.
remainingUncertainty: Exact WUP point coverage and source completeness remain unverified; no citywide or countrywide completeness claim is made.
nextStep: Root review can retain this city-specific custody evidence and pursue a source-native public feature route only if one is identified.
